scope.query: site:ocw.mit.edu compiler course lectures assignments projects MIT compiler design

pairs.earlier: MIT OCW compiler course lecture notes assignments compiler university free

evidence.answer:
MIT OCW’s best match is 6.035, Computer Language Engineering. It includes lecture notes, problem sets, and five compiler-design projects. ([ocw.mit.edu](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-035-computer-language-engineering-sma-5502-fall-2005/pages/projects/))

For a shorter introduction, see the compiler material in 6.004, Computation Structures. ([ocw.mit.edu](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-004-computation-structures-spring-2017/pages/c11/))

pairs.earlier: Y Combinator Winter 2027 batch dates San Francisco official

evidence.answer: Y Combinator’s Winter 2027 batch runs January through March 2027 in person in San Francisco. YC hasn’t published exact start and end dates on its official page. The on-time application deadline is November 2 at 8 p.m. PT; applicants who apply by then should receive a decision by December 11. ([ycombinator.com](https://www.ycombinator.com/apply))

pairs.earlier: site:ocw.mit.edu compiler design course assignments lectures compiler MIT OCW 6.035

evidence.answer: MIT OCW’s 6.035 course is Computer Language Engineering, focused on compiler design and implementation. The Spring 2010 course has lecture notes and project assignments covering scanning and parsing, semantic analysis, code generation, data-flow analysis, and optimization. ([ocw.mit.edu](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-035-computer-language-engineering-spring-2010/))
